description: This Java class EntityTagValueValidator validates the value of HTTP Entity Tags (ETags) against RFC standards, throwing an exception if invalid.

classes.name: EntityTagValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class extending AbstractHeaderValueValidator that validates Entity Tag header values according to RFC 7232.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of EntityTagValueValidator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the provided header value as an Entity Tag; throws an exception if invalid.
